name: Shanshan Yao
title: Associate Professor
fitReason: A visitor-first interdisciplinary option for a software-centered project in biosignal decoding or multimodal robot interaction. Much of the group focuses on materials and sensing, so an AI implementation/evaluation project should be agreed explicitly rather than assumed from its broader robotics description.

physicalEvidence.summary: The complete author-hosted paper, published online October 1, 2024 and in a February 2025 journal issue, uses two temporal convolutional networks for speaker and keyword recognition from facial EMG. Decoded commands are passed through MQTT/ROS to a real manipulator for three computer-component assembly/disassembly scenarios, including two human operators. Parts occupy predefined locations; Vicon marker tracking and a hand-flip trigger coordinate handovers. This is learned intent decoding coupled to physical execution, not an end-to-end learned motion policy. The paper reports five-speaker, eighteen-keyword classification validation separately from the proof-of-concept robot demonstrations. Yao is corresponding author and the first author identifies her as his PhD supervisor. Exact robot model and campus ownership were not established, so the score is capped at 20. The May 2025 drone article reports a command-classification dataset and neural network; its accessible evidence does not verify real flight.

shortVisit.summary: The university-hosted lab Openings page explicitly welcomes visiting students earning degrees at SBU or their home institutions, and requests a CV, research interests and supporting materials by email. This is a direct external-student inquiry route. The page is undated; its complete external-student invitation was verified live in the cloud browser after text extraction initially failed. It does not state a summer 2027 vacancy, eight-week minimum/maximum, stipend, personal-funding condition, or remote option.
